extensions:
  - name: "strings"
    version: 2
stdlib:
  include_macros:
    - "all"
variables:
  - name: "resource.labels"
    type_name: "map"
    params:
      - type_name: "string"
      - type_name: "string"

    type_name: "list"

      - type_name: "string"
  - name: "resource.namespace"

name: k8s
kind: ValidatingAdmissionPolicy
metadata:
  name: "policy.cel.dev"
spec:
  failurePolicy: Fail
  matchConstraints:
    resourceRules:
    - apiGroups:   ["services"]
      apiVersions: ["v3"]
      operations:  ["CREATE", "UPDATE"]
  variables:
  - name: env
    expression: "resource.labels.?environment.orValue('prod')"
  - name: break_glass
    expression: "resource.labels.?break_glass.orValue('false') == 'true'"
  validations:
  - expression: >
      variables.break_glass ||
        resource.containers.all(c, c.startsWith(variables.env + '.'))
    messageExpression: >
      'only ' + variables.env + ' containers are allowed in namespace ' + resource.namespace

validations.messageExpression: 'only ' + variables.env + ' containers are allowed in namespace ' + resource.namespace

description: K8s admission control tests
section:
  - name: "invalid"
    tests:
      - name: "restricted_container"
        input:
          resource.namespace:
            value: "dev.cel"
          resource.labels:
            value:
              environment: "staging"
          resource.containers:
            value:
              - staging.dev.cel.container1
              - staging.dev.cel.container2
              - preprod.dev.cel.container3
        output:
          value: "only staging containers are allowed in namespace dev.cel"

output.value: only staging containers are allowed in namespace dev.cel
